design_brief: Elegant curved streams of translucent pink cherry-blossom petals, lavender spirit ribbons, tiny warm gold pollen lights and a few cyan accents taken from the reference. Fine airy botanical magic, no background fog.
limits: This is one combined peak texture; individual particles are not separately controllable within it.
Do not replace or modify frame PNG; keep this on a separate effect layer.
